description: Every Pax8 Partner API endpoint, plus an offline store that reconciles billing, tracks MRR, and catches usage overages no Pax8 tool surfaces.

novel_features.name: Billing reconciliation
novel_features.description: Flag invoice lines that no longer match an active subscription, and active subscriptions that never got billed; --draft pre-checks the next unposted invoice.

novel_features.name: MRR and margin
novel_features.description: Compute monthly recurring revenue and margin from subscriptions and product pricing, trended across syncs, with a per-product breakdown.

novel_features.name: Usage overage detection
novel_features.description: Aggregate usage-lines per subscription and surface overages before they land on the customer invoice.

novel_features.name: Subscription change feed
novel_features.description: Show subscription changes in a window: synced history events plus subscriptions created or updated in it.

novel_features.name: Customer 360
novel_features.description: One view of a company with its subscriptions, contacts, invoices, and usage.

novel_features.name: Spend per company
novel_features.description: Roll up invoice-items by company to show what each customer is costing across invoices.
